company.description: Tyltgo provides courier, logistics, supply chain management, and delivery services for small businesses and enterprises. The company was founded in July 2018 by Aaron Paul and Jaden Pereira and is headquartered in Kitchener, Ontario, Canada.

productsAndServices.description: Logistics services focused on the final step of delivery from distribution centers to customers’ doorsteps, optimizing speed and customer experience.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $1,826,545, or 92.24% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,045,172 to $9,151,295, a 8.76x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
